echo-prints-text.title: `echo` Produces Text
echo-prints-text.bodyMarkdown:
`echo` writes text to terminal output.

```bash
echo "Workshop opens at 9"
```

By itself, it does not save that text to a file.

write-with-greater-than.title: Write or Replace with `>`
write-with-greater-than.bodyMarkdown: `>` redirects command output into a file. It creates the file when needed and replaces existing content when the file already exists.

append-with-double-greater-than.title: Append with `>>`
append-with-double-greater-than.bodyMarkdown: `>>` redirects output to the end of a file while preserving the content already there. Read the finished file to verify the line order.
